title: listar: splitter — quantity parsing (digits, number words, units, x2/per-dos patterns) (TDD)
description:
Quantity extraction per segment: digits, Spanish number words, units, 'x2'/'por dos' patterns. Canonical rule (spec §Item Splitter): container/count words (docena, paquete, caja) stay as unit with their count — never multiplied; physical measures keep parsed number. Output uses label (normalized product) + text (raw phrase). Dangling quantity → raw phrase as label. Duplicates: same label merges (sum qty when units match). node:test. Spec: listar/spec/functionality.md.
MUST: node --test listar/test/splitter.test.js passes every row of the spec quantity table plus dangling-quantity and duplicate-merge cases from the golden corpus.
ANTI-GOALS: no LLM/API calls; no new splitting heuristics beyond quantities; no fixture weakening. Co-owns listar/splitter.js — land after jams-asb.

title: listar: copy transcribir worker.js + audio decode/mic stack
description:
Port transcribir's stack into listar/worker.js: transformers.js Whisper module worker, CDN fallbacks, abort/retry/progress, chunked 30s inference — PLUS the transcript filter (spec §Transcript Filter): drop <2-word/low-confidence segments, empty→'no se escuchó nada claro' state, chunk-timestamp attribution. Audio decode→mono→16 kHz + MediaRecorder mic flow go in script.js only as far as worker integration requires. Spec: listar/spec/functionality.md.
MUST: node --check listar/worker.js passes; message protocol (transcribe/cancel/progress/result/error/cancelled) identical to transcribir; filter unit-tested (silence/hallucination fixtures) in listar/test/; CDN URLs pinned.
HANDOFF (HITL): on-device smoke test with tiny model is the release gate — tagged for jams-rte verification, not autonomous AFK.
ANTI-GOALS: no UI changes; no model map changes; no splitting logic in the worker.

title: listar: db.js IndexedDB wrapper (TDD)
description:
IndexedDB wrapper: List/Item/Audio stores, CRUD, ordering, per-list queries. fake-indexeddb in node:test. Spec: listar/spec/functionality.md (§Data Model).
MUST: node --test listar/test/db.test.js passes CRUD + ordering + per-list query cases; schema matches spec stores/fields exactly.
ANTI-GOALS: no UI wiring; no migration logic; db.js carries Purpose/Responsibilities/Rationale header.

title: listar: splitter — connector splitting (y, e, comma, luego, además) (TDD)
description:
Splitter phase 2: connector words (y, e, comma, luego, después, también, además) split segments only when followed by a plausible item start (predicate defined in spec §CLAR-001 fix). node:test. Spec: listar/spec/functionality.md.
MUST: node --test listar/test/splitter.test.js passes connector positives AND negative fixtures (phrases containing connector words that must NOT split, e.g. product names).
ANTI-GOALS: no quantity parsing; no changes to marker logic from jams-3n2; no fixture weakening. Co-owns listar/splitter.js — land after jams-3n2.

title: listar: splitter — explicit markers & line breaks (TDD)
description:
Red→green→refactor: splitter.js parses numbered (1., 1)) and bulleted (-, •, *) markers and line breaks into items. Pure ESM module. Spec: listar/spec/functionality.md (§Item Splitter).
MUST: node --test listar/test/splitter.test.js passes ≥8 cases: numbered '1.', '1)', 'uno)', bullets '-, •, *', line breaks, mixed markers, no-marker fallback = single item.
ANTI-GOALS: no connector logic (jams-asb), no quantity parsing (jams-1i9), no fixture weakening. splitter.js carries a Purpose/Responsibilities/Rationale header. Co-owns listar/splitter.js with jams-asb, jams-1i9 (sequential — land in dep order).
